positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Support Macy’s ongoing modernization from its legacy C/C++ SPOS platform to the Enactor solution by using generative AI to analyze legacy business logic, synthesize knowledge-transfer sessions into technical documentation and Mermaid process flows, and accelerate implementation of features such as Find Merchandise and Place Order; serve as a go-to resource for CRU form development and production deployment across Enactor teams.

- Served as a senior technical authority for Macy’s legacy C/C++ point-of-sale platform, advising team leads on implementation estimates, codebase best practices, and production deployments while leading the year-long customer-facing migration from Verifone MX925 to M450 devices in direct collaboration with Verifone; resolved CRU form, FiPay integration, connectivity, and package-deployment performance issues. 

- Led cross-functional delivery of a streamlined Marketplace Returns process, earning the 2024 Macy’s Digital and Technology Award.

- Guided contractors new to C/C++ through the initial Marketplace Returns implementation, earning the 2023 Macy’s Digital and Technology Award.

- Supported testing and migration of production and test Internal Server Processors from Red Hat 6 and JBoss to Red Hat 7 and WildFly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed components of a secure encryption API on Google Cloud Platform, supporting the retirement of a legacy mainframe application. 

- Integrated a Java Spring application with Cloud Bigtable to provide scalable, low-latency caching for enterprise application data. 

- Designed the architecture for Pay By Link in Macy's POS and led five contractors through implementation and testing.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed software for a highly successful new IoT solution in the water market
• Worked on Email and SMS alert notifications as a service out of the platform
• Led the POC for Kubernetes migration of all services on the platform, which reduced the hosting cost of the solution by half
• Responsible for developing secure API for third party consumption using standards like OIDC and API key authentication
• Responsible for automating third-party IAM solution configuration for new environments
• Improved code quality by implementing minimal test code coverage
• Organized and led sprint retrospectives
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Spring Framework · Software Development · Java · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with the Software Analytics Team to develop, maintain, and test the utility application
•	Learned bash scripting and worked on optimizing pre-written onboarding scripts
•	Attended sprint planning meetings and daily developer calls for team organization
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Spring Framework · Software Development · Java · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:

•	Graded 50 student’s homework, tests, and quizzes
•	Assisted professor with minor class-related tasks
